description:
As a provisioning service, I need to normalize operator-supplied MAC addresses to a single canonical form before storing them, so that addresses written with different separators or casing compare equal.

The function normalize_mac(mac: str) -> str returns the MAC in upper-case colon form 'AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF'.
acceptance_criteria: A Cisco dotted address 'aabb.ccdd.eeff' normalizes to 'AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF'.
An address with non-hex characters (e.g. 'gg:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff') raises ValueError.
An address with the wrong number of digits (e.g. 'aa:bb:cc') raises ValueError.
flowchart_mermaid:
flowchart TD
    A[Receive mac string] --> B[Strip separators : - .]
    B --> C{Exactly 12 chars?}
    C -->|no| E[Raise ValueError]
    C -->|yes| D{All hex digits?}
    D -->|no| E
    D -->|yes| F[Upper-case and split into pairs]
    F --> G[Join with colons -> AA:BB:...]
